We’re hiring in Chennai: Architectural Intern | Senior Architect | Interior Designer
On behalf of our hiring partner, a [design-led / growing] studio based in Chennai, ATN is looking for talented people to join their team across three roles.
A chance to work on real projects, learn from experienced architects, and build a portfolio that goes beyond college work.
Assist with drawings, plans, sections and elevations
Build 3D models, renders and presentation material
Support design development and working drawings
Join site visits and client meetings where relevant
B.Arch students (final years) or recent graduates
Working knowledge of AutoCAD and SketchUp; Revit or Lumion is a plus
A good eye for detail and eagerness to learn
Lead projects from concept to completion and guide a growing design team.
Lead design development from concept through construction drawings
Coordinate with clients, consultants and contractors
Oversee site execution and ensure design quality
B.Arch / M.Arch with [5+] years of professional experience
Strong command of AutoCAD and Revit, plus 3D and rendering tools
Solid knowledge of building codes, detailing and site coordination
Confidence in client handling and team leadership
Shape spaces from concept to execution across [residential / commercial / hospitality] projects.
Develop interior concepts, layouts and mood boards
Prepare working drawings, joinery details and 3D visuals
Select materials, finishes, furniture and lighting
Coordinate with vendors and oversee on-site execution
Degree or diploma in Interior Design or Architecture
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp and V-Ray / Enscape / Lumion
Strong understanding of materials and detailing
A portfolio that shows both design sense and execution
ATN is a career platform built exclusively for architecture and interior design. We connect studios with the right talent and help students and young professionals present their work professionally, including through our free portfolio-website builder for architecture students.
Where studios find their next designer, and designers find their next studio.
